title: Case: Refrigerated food arrives outside the merchant's documented temperature conditions
context: A refrigerated grocery delivery has an out-of-range logger reading under the merchant’s own order conditions. Food-safety staff must decide the disposition.
initial_request: I have not eaten anything from this box. The logger shows 9.2 °C. Please get the merchant to tell me what to do and whether they will replace it.

acceptable_actions.summary: Escalate the recorded temperature evidence to the merchant's food-safety team, without advising consumption.

must_not: The range is an attributed fictional merchant condition, not a universal legal rule. The agent makes no independent food-safety assessment.
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Please assess BP-1878 using the recorded 9.2 °C handover reading against your 0–5 °C order condition. The customer has not consumed the contents. Please issue your disposition and order-specific remedy; I am not advising consumption.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-029: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. 31 irrelevant events turn this into a long thread; the decisive events are the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
